# Solar Bill

> Free web app that reads Pakistani net-metering electricity bills (LESCO, IESCO, FESCO, GEPCO, MEPCO, PESCO, HESCO) and explains them in plain words: import vs export units, peak vs off-peak cost, quarterly settlement, carried-forward credit, and solar savings. Bills are read inside the browser; signing in with Google saves them by consumer ID.

- [Homepage](https://solarbill.pk/): what Solar Bill does, why a net exporter can still get a bill, bill terms glossary, 2026 NEPRA rule changes, FAQ
- [Check a bill](https://solarbill.pk/app): the app; add a DISCO web-bill PDF
- [Sample bill](https://solarbill.pk/app?sample=1): a worked LESCO example
- [Privacy Policy](https://solarbill.pk/privacy): what is stored, who processes it, and how to delete it
- [Terms of Service](https://solarbill.pk/terms): terms of use; figures are informational and the DISCO bill is the official record
